stance_basis: letter explicitly objects to ORV noise threatening wildlife refuge and human seekers of peace and quiet in nature
summary: Min Thin Keller of River Falls, Wisconsin wrote a brief letter opposing ORV use on public lands, arguing that the noise from ORVs threatens wildlife refuge and disturbs other humans who seek peace and quiet in natural settings. Keller urges that man-made machine noise not be allowed to encroach on natural areas.
complaint_summary: Keller objects to ORV noise on public lands, stating it threatens wildlife refuge and disturbs humans seeking peace and quiet in nature, and urges that man-made machine noise not be allowed to encroach on natural areas.
